name: phase-timing-report
body: The per-phase timing breakdown emitted as first-class scan output: one measured duration per scan phase (frontend execution, ingest/graph assembly, DB load, startup/overhead) for a single scan, including the fast-path marker when the frontend phase was skipped. It is the report the `phase-timing` value measures and that the phase-timer component produces; it lets the incremental wins be compared against the recorded full-scan baseline.
